use: For the swimlanes of a workflow on a `sherpa-layout-canvas`: one row each, in its `rows` slot, the whole width, its name at the start of what the view shows. Its host writes where it stands and how tall (`data-y`, `data-h`, plane px) and its colour; `data-type="junction"` is the band between two lanes where a logic node stands. It takes no press. For columns across the canvas, use `sherpa-node-stage`.
